cases.question: 最近30天（2026年8月14日至9月12日）中，有哪些地区-分类组合的销售金额高于该地区各组合的平均销售金额？（请给出地区、分类与销售额，取前10）
cases.gold_sql: WITH pair_sales AS (SELECT o.region, c.name AS cat_name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-08-14' AND o.order_date <= '2026-09-12' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, c.id, c.name HAVING SUM(oi.subtotal) > 30000) SELECT ps.region, ps.cat_name, ROUND(ps.revenue, 2) AS revenue FROM pair_sales ps WHERE ps.revenue > (SELECT AVG(t.avg_rev) FROM (SELECT region, AVG(revenue) AS avg_rev FROM pair_sales GROUP BY region) t WHERE t.region = ps.region) ORDER BY ps.revenue DESC, ps.region, ps.cat_name LIMIT 10
cases.pred_sql: WITH region_category_sales AS (SELECT o.region, c.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-14' AND '2026-09-12' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region, c.id), region_avg_sales AS (SELECT region, AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales FROM region_category_sales GROUP BY region) SELECT rcs.region, rcs.category_name, rcs.total_sales FROM region_category_sales rcs JOIN region_avg_sales ras ON rcs.region = ras.region WHERE rcs.total_sales > ras.avg_sales ORDER BY rcs.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10
cases.root_cause: 遗漏题面显式过滤条件/阈值（如 HAVING>30000）导致基准失真

cases.question: 2025年中，商品销售金额高于全国地区平均销售金额、且订单笔数也高于全国地区平均订单笔数的区域有哪些？（请给出地区、销售额与订单数）
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.subtotal), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.region HAVING SUM(oi.subtotal) > (SELECT AVG(v.revenue) FROM (SELECT region, SUM(oi2.subtotal) AS revenue FROM orders o2 JOIN order_items oi2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.id WHERE o2.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o2.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o2.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o2.region) v) AND COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) > (SELECT AVG(w.orders) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o3.id) AS orders FROM orders o3 JOIN order_items oi3 ON oi3.order_id = o3.id WHERE o3.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o3.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND o3.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o3.region) w) ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.region
cases.pred_sql: WITH region_stats AS (SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(id) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY region), national_avg AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_sales), 2) AS avg_sales, ROUND(AVG(order_count), 2) AS avg_orders FROM region_stats) SELECT rs.region, rs.total_sales, rs.order_count FROM region_stats rs, national_avg na WHERE rs.total_sales > na.avg_sales AND rs.order_count > na.avg_orders ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC
cases.root_cause: 金额字段选错（subtotal vs total_amount / price vs unit_price）

cases.question: 每个商品分类中，销量最高的3款商品分别是哪些？（请给出分类、商品名与销量；仅统计销量超过50的商品）
cases.gold_sql: WITH cat_prod AS (SELECT c.name AS cat_name, p.name AS prod_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, p.id, p.name HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) > 50), ranked AS (SELECT cat_name, prod_name, sold, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cat_name ORDER BY sold DESC) AS rk FROM cat_prod) SELECT cat_name, prod_name, sold AS sold_qty FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 3 ORDER BY cat_name, rk
cases.pred_sql: WITH ranked_products AS (SELECT c.name AS category_name, p.name AS product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC) AS rn FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, p.id HAVING SUM(oi.quantity) > 50) SELECT category_name, product_name, total_sold FROM ranked_products WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY category_name, total_sold DESC
cases.root_cause: 排名题并列无稳定 tiebreaker，结果非确定性
